local toast={Text=""};local os={clock=function()return 100 end}
local toastUntil=0;local toastWidth=0
local function notify(t) toast.Text=t;toastUntil=os.clock()+math.clamp(#t/22,4,12);toastWidth=0 end
notify('LEVEL 10 milestone');notify('Quest reward: +100 XP')
assert(toast.Text=='Quest reward: +100 XP')
print('REPRODUCED same-frame milestone overwritten: '..toast.Text)
notify('Quest complete! Claim your reward in Quests.');notify('Flowers watered')
assert(toast.Text=='Flowers watered')
print('REPRODUCED same-frame completion overwritten: '..toast.Text)
